newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar in dull late trading on Monday.

Dealers said volume was thin, with the focus mainly on the fluctuating money market. Overnight rupiah soared to a high of 24.0 percent in the afternoon from a low of 12.5/13.0 percent before settling later at 19.0 percent.
One European bank dealer said the rupiah was relatively firm despite the on-going election campaign, keeping it hovering in a range between 2,425.0 and 2,430.0.
Spot rupiah was at 2,425.25/26.25 at 0900 GMT against an opening of 2,429.0/30.0. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,425.0/25.5 and 2,426.5/27.0, respectively.
"Sentiment on the rupiah improved slightly after liquidity turned tighter. We saw some people short the dollar but they covered it back later," the European bank dealer said.
He said the rupiah should remain firm on Tuesday on extended tightening due to weekly tax payments.
Another dealer said short-term swaps edged up as a result.
Tom/next swap increased to 0.6/0.7 and one-week to 2.9/3.1.
Another dealer said earlier there was not much room for the rupiah to appreciate because of underlying campaign worries which will last until the May 29 polls.
One-month swaps were at 13.50/14.25, two at 25.0/26.0, three at 38.00/38.15 and six at 76.0/77.0 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,407/2,599 and the conversion band at 2,407/2,455 on Monday.
